evals.prompt: Does Princeton University Library have Chinese books with 明史 in the title? Show the oldest ones and where they are shelved.
evals.expected_output: Alma SRU title search at Princeton for 明史, Chinese language, oldest first, with vernacular titles and AVA call numbers
expectations: The Alma SRU endpoint was queried (princeton.alma.exlibrisgroup.com/view/sru)
The title index was searched for 明史, with language chi
Results were sorted by date ascending, with unknown dates excluded or noted
Titles are shown in Chinese characters (from 880 fields)
Call numbers and locations from AVA fields are given
The library's public website was not scraped

evals.prompt: Find books by Benjamin A. Elman at Princeton and tell me which ones I can read online.
evals.expected_output: Author search with AVE electronic holdings identified
expectations: Results separate print (AVA) from online (AVE) holdings

evals.prompt: I found OCLC number 424023 in WorldCat. Does Princeton hold it, and is there a digitized copy?
evals.expected_output: OCLC lookup in Princeton Alma, then HathiTrust check
expectations: The record title and holdings are reported
The hathitrust-catalog skill or HathiTrust API was used for the digitized-copy question
